items.q: What is the starting price at The Samsaara?
items.a: Stays start from ₹2,000 per person per night in our Standard AC cottages, with meals included (MAP plan). Deluxe, Superior and camping prices change with dates and group size, so message us on WhatsApp for the best current price.

items.q: Are meals included in the price?
items.a: Yes. All cottage and camping stays are on a MAP plan, so your meals are included. Our in-house café also serves snacks, pizzas and more through the day.

items.q: Can I book a single bed instead of a full cottage?
items.a: Yes. Each cottage has 4–5 beds and you can book per bed or take the whole cottage for your group. We customise the arrangement to suit you.

items.q: Where exactly is The Samsaara located?
items.a: We are on the bank of the Ganga in the Shivpuri range, about 16–20 km upstream of Rishikesh town on the Badrinath highway. Shivpuri is the main rafting hub of Rishikesh. See our How to Reach page for directions.

items.q: Do you arrange river rafting?
items.a: Yes, we can arrange river rafting in Shivpuri for our guests, along with bonfire, beach volleyball and other group activities. Tell us your group size and dates and we will plan it for you.

items.q: Is there a swimming pool?
items.a: Yes, the resort has a swimming pool for guests, along with a river front, indoor and outdoor games, and a café.

items.q: Do you offer group discounts?
items.a: Yes. We don't sell fixed packages — every group gets a custom package with a group discount. Share your group size, dates and what you'd like to do on WhatsApp and we'll send a quote.

items.q: How many guests can you host for a destination wedding?
items.a: We host intimate riverside weddings for 70–100 guests, with catering and décor included. Message us with your dates for a custom quote.

items.q: Can we do a pre-wedding shoot at the resort?
items.a: Yes. The riverside beach, cottages and pool area are popular for pre-wedding shoots. Contact us to plan the timing and any setup you need.

items.q: Is The Samsaara suitable for school and college groups?
items.a: Yes. We host school and college groups with custom packages that include stay, meals and supervised activities. We'll work with teachers and organisers on the itinerary.

items.q: Can we host a corporate offsite or team outing?
items.a: Yes. We host corporate groups for team outings and offsites, with stay, meals, rafting, bonfire evenings and team activities planned around your agenda. Wi-Fi is available.

items.q: Can you host a birthday party or celebration?
items.a: Yes. We host destination birthdays and private celebrations with bonfire, music and karaoke, café food and riverside setups. Message us with your plans.

items.q: Is Wi-Fi and parking available?
items.a: Yes, we have Wi-Fi and on-site parking for guests.

items.q: How do I book?
items.a: The fastest way is WhatsApp on +91 70781 14023. You can also call us or fill in the enquiry form on our Contact page and we'll get back to you with availability and the best price.

items.q: How many riverside cottages are there at The Samsaara?
items.a: There are 17 air-conditioned cottages in Shivpuri, Rishikesh, in Standard, Deluxe and Superior tiers. Each cottage has 4–5 beds, and meals are included on the MAP plan.

items.q: How far are the cottages from Rishikesh town and the railway station?
items.a: The resort is approximately 16–20 km (35–45 minutes) from Laxman Jhula and Tapovan, and approximately 20–22 km (45–55 minutes) from Rishikesh railway station and Yog Nagari.

items.q: Are the cottages near the river Ganga?
items.a: Yes. The Samsaara is on the bank of the Ganga in Shivpuri and guests have river front access, along with the swimming pool, café, bonfire area and games.

items.q: Where is your riverside camping site in Rishikesh?
items.a: Our camp is on the river beach in Shivpuri, upstream of Rishikesh town. There are 10 tents, so the site stays small.

items.q: What is included in night camping at The Samsaara?
items.a: Your tent stay includes meals on the MAP plan and bonfire evenings, with access to the pool, café and games. Rafting can be arranged on request.

items.q: What is the price of riverside camping per night?
items.a: Camping prices change with the season, weekdays or weekends and group size. Send your dates and guest count on WhatsApp for the current price.

items.q: Which is the best time for camping near the Ganga in Shivpuri?
items.a: Roughly October to June is best for beach camping. River activities are usually paused during the monsoon for safety, so check with us before planning.

items.q: What is included in a wedding at your Rishikesh resort?
items.a: Every wedding gets a custom quote covering the riverside venue, guest stay, catering and décor. There are no fixed packages.

items.q: Where will our wedding guests stay?
items.a: Guests stay on site in our 17 AC cottages and riverside tents, so family and friends are together for every function.

items.q: How far is the wedding resort from Delhi and Dehradun airport?
items.a: Shivpuri is approximately 240 km (6–7 hours) by road from Delhi and approximately 35–40 km (60–75 minutes) from Jolly Grant airport in Dehradun.
